content_sections.heading: About ECHS Nagpur Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The Ex-Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme (ECHS) works under the Ministry of Defence, Government of India. This employment notice is issued by Station HQ (ECHS Cell), Nagpur and is for staff of the ECHS Polyclinic located in Nagpur, Maharashtra. The notice and its annexures carry the vetting stamp of C Int O, HQ MC, IAF.

content_sections.heading: Post-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice announces 3 vacancies in total, one for each post. No category-wise break-up is printed.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The notice calls these the Qualitative Requirements (QRs). Only candidates meeting the Qualitative Requirement may apply. The application form asks for the registration number and date of registration with the Indian/State Medical Council, with a photocopy of the registration attached, and the experience certificate must be attached for experience to be considered. For the exact eligibility of each post, candidates should check the official notification.

rows.qualification: BAMS degree from a college recognized by National Commission of Indian System of Medicine (NCISM). Valid registration with NCISM or equivalent State Medicine Board/Council.
B. Pharma or D. Pharma (Ayurveda) from a college recognized by Central / State govt. Valid registration in concerned State/UT.

rows.experience: Minimum 3 years work experience in the Specialty after Post Graduation

rows.desirable_attributes: Merit in MBBS, PG qualification, Experience of more than 10 years
Merit in MBBS, Merit in PG, Additional qualification

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: The notice gives only an upper age limit for each post, counted as on 01 Apr 26. No minimum age and no age relaxation are printed.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Each post carries a fixed remuneration (shown as contractual fees per month in the QR table): Ayurveda Doctor Rs. 95,000/-, Ayurveda Pharmacist Rs. 36,500/- and Medical Specialist Rs. 1,30,000/-. The official notification does not mention the in-hand salary. Priority will be given to ESMs. After selection, ESMs will have the option to choose either the fixed pay mentioned above or the pay arrived at by deducting the basic pension from the pay drawn at the time of retirement plus transport allowance not exceeding the rate applicable to the appointee at the time of retirement (whichever is beneficial). Contract period: 11 months, renewable for an additional period of one year/till attaining the maximum age subject to performance of candidate/other conditions. The second year employment is allowed on extension after the first year, subject to satisfactory conduct and performance in the first year based on the Appraisal System. The contractual employee will not be entitled to any allowances, financial benefits or concessions as admissible to Government employees. Working hours: 48 hours per week (8 hours x 6 days) from Monday to Saturday; Sunday is a holiday. Leave: 2.5 days for every completed month during the contractual period, which will lapse, if accumulated, at the end of six months. This leave is besides Sundays and Gazetted Holidays. Termination: the contract can be terminated by either side by giving one month's notice.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications are shortlisted and the shortlisted candidates are called for an interview, where original certificates are verified. All shortlisted candidates will be informed through telephone and e-mail, and their names will be displayed at Main Gate (Futala Gate) of HQ MC, VSN, Nagpur-07. The interview date and timing are communicated in this way; the notice does not print them. The interview of shortlisted candidates of all three posts will be held at Station HQs ECHS, Vayusena Nagar, Nagpur-440007. Candidates must bring all original certificates/mark sheets/degree of 10th/Matric, 10+2 and Graduation/Post Graduation/Diploma/course, work experience, Discharge Book, PPO service record and 02 PP size colour photographs. No TA/DA is admissible.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ECHS Nagpur Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill in the application form for employment in ECHS, writing the name of the post and of the polyclinic applied for, and affix a recent passport size photograph (do not staple it). Give your age as on 01 Apr 2026, educational qualifications, work experience, registration details and, for ex-servicemen, the service details asked for in the form. Attach self-attested photocopies of the documents listed below, including the Medical Fitness Certificate in the format given with the notice. Sign the declaration on the form. Send the application to Station Commander ECHS, HQ MC(U) AF, Vayusena Nagar, Nagpur-440007, or deposit it in the application box kept at Main Gate (Futala Gate) of HQ MC, VSN, Nagpur. Make sure the application reaches by 13 December 2026; any application received after 13 Dec 26 will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: One set of photocopies, duly self-attested, is to be attached with the application form in this sequence: Aadhar Card PAN Card Matriculation Certificate 12th Certificate Graduation Certificate Diploma / Degree PPO, Discharge Book, ESM I-Card (for ESM only) Medical Fitness Certificate Experience Certificate (as applicable) No Objection Certificate from current employer (if applicable) The general instructions also ask for one passport size photograph and residence address proof. The Medical Fitness Certificate format provided in the notice is signed by a Medical Officer with stamp and countersigned by the SEMO/CMO, and records the candidate's age as on 01 Apr 2026.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Only a duly filled-in application supported by all required documents will be accepted; incomplete applications will not be accepted. Candidates who were earlier employed in ECHS but whose services were terminated need not apply. Any information in the application found false or incorrect can lead to action against the candidate. For additional details, contact Stn HQ (ECHS Cell) Nagpur at 0712-2512771, Extn:7695, 0712-2990062 or e-mail [email protected] .

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are in ECHS Nagpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: one Ayurveda Doctor, one Ayurveda Pharmacist and one Medical Specialist at the ECHS Polyclinic Nagpur.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application must reach the Station Commander ECHS by 13 December 2026. Any application received after 13 Dec 26 will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the ECHS Nagpur posts?
faq.answer: Ayurveda Doctor needs a BAMS degree from an NCISM-recognized college with valid registration and 3 years' experience after internship; Ayurveda Pharmacist needs B. Pharma or D. Pharma (Ayurveda) with valid State/UT registration and 3 years' experience; Medical Specialist needs MD/MS in Specialty concerned/DNB with 3 years' experience in the Specialty after Post Graduation.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit as on 01 Apr 26 is 66 for Ayurveda Doctor, 56 for Ayurveda Pharmacist and 68 for Medical Specialist.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for ECHS Nagpur posts?
faq.answer: The fixed remuneration is Rs. 95,000/- for Ayurveda Doctor, Rs. 36,500/- for Ayurveda Pharmacist and Rs. 1,30,000/- for Medical Specialist per month.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Send the filled application form with self-attested documents to Station Commander ECHS, HQ MC(U) AF, Vayusena Nagar, Nagpur-440007, or deposit it in the application box at Main Gate (Futala Gate) of HQ MC, VSN, Nagpur.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates are informed by telephone and e-mail and interviewed at Station HQs ECHS, Vayusena Nagar, Nagpur-440007, where original certificates are verified.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is on contract for 11 months, renewable for an additional period of one year/till attaining the maximum age subject to performance, and either side can end it with one month's notice.

faq.question: Q9. Do ex-servicemen get any preference?
faq.answer: Yes. Priority will be given to ESMs, and after selection they can choose the fixed pay or last pay drawn minus basic pension plus transport allowance, whichever is beneficial.

faq.question: Q10. Is TA/DA paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA is admissible.
